title: Our Barcelona Adventure
text: I would highly recommend this tour! Reme, who coordinated everything was very responsive and friendly. Carlos (our guide/driver) was professional, knowledgeable, accommodating, friendly, and punctual. Together with my 6 year old, I was able to see all the sights that were important and interesting to me, stress free and in comfort. We only had a single day in Barcelona so we needed to make the most of our time. title: Great personalized, air-conditioned tour of Barcelona!
text:
TOUR: The tour was outstanding! We had a wonderful time! Everything was excellent. The driver did an excellent job explaining things and giving history, and taking us to our desired stops while also adding his expertise. We had friends and family along, from a 10-year-old and young adults, to over 60. One might think an 8-hour tour would perhaps be too long, but the time absolutely flew by, and we "did Barcelona in a day!" So much fun!

title: Excellent day trip!!!
text: It almost a customized tour. The entire trip was awesome. Carlos did an excellent job accommodating our requests. The finale was the recommended place where we had our lunch. Had been here in Barcelona 4 times but there is always something new every time I visit this wonderful place.
author: Jason_B

title: Money well spent to see all you can in a day in Barcelona! Fantastic company
text: This was  fantastic experience! Money well spent for the four of us to see all we could in Barcelona the day before our cruise. Had a private van that was clean and cool and picked up on time by Heriberto who was a wonderful guide. He navigated well and knew always where to drop us off and pick us up and communicated well. Prior to our tour, I had emailed what we wanted to do and this tour company not only took the time to suggest what timing would be best for various tickets we wanted (be sure to get in advance as they sell out in busy times) but also to attach the links to the official sites
author: Stacy_H

title: Great tour!
text: Wonderful experience.  Very knowledgeable driver, prompt and informing. Highly recommended. Visited sites that we feel otherwise would have been missed if we toured with a group
author: Visitor-Jan2023

title: Exactly what we wanted!
text:
We got off the cruise ship at 8:00 and wanted a quick tour of Barcelona before flying out. 
Our driver, Pedro was awesome. His English wasn’t perfect, but close enough to be easily understood. The car was clean and comfortable. As we only had a few hours, he took us to the main attractions, snapped some photos, and had us at the airport as scheduled. Highly recommend them.
author: Anonymous

title: Excellent service and cars are nice and clean. Drivers and Reme did a good job. On time and friendly
text: Excellent service and cars are nice and clean. Drivers and Reme did a good job. On time and friendly and knowledgeable. Will book again when we go back to Barcelona. Thanks Reme for taking care of us.

title: Very well organized and professional!
text:
I book J&G for transport to and from the racetrack during the F1 in Barcelona. 
I contacted them last minute, but they replied immediately, and helped me out with the planning. Very friendly and very well organized. 
I had them for 2 days and after every day I was contacted and asked if everything was ok and to my satisfaction.
